items.title: Is That Government Fee Actually a Tax?
items.description:

items.title: This is how we are supporting communities in Tigray, Ethiopia

items.title: How can ICRC's humanitarian action help lay the foundations for a more peaceful future?

items.title: From Maryam in Nigeria to her husband, missing for ten years | ICRC
items.description:

Since then, joy has never felt the same. Still, she holds on to the hope that one day, he will come home.
